from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
smi='CC1(C)c2cccc(P(c3ccccc3)c3ccccc3)c2Oc2c(P(c3ccccc3)c3ccccc3)cccc21.C1=CC(Nc2ccccc2)CCC=C1'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
rw=Chem.RWMol(m)
pd=Chem.Atom('Pd'); pd.SetNoImplicit(True)
pdi=rw.AddAtom(pd)
for i in (8,25,42,43): rw.AddBond(i,pdi,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
m=rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print('atoms',m.GetNumAtoms(),'Pd',pdi, 'counts', [(x.GetSymbol(),sum(a.GetSymbol()==x.GetSymbol() for a in m.GetAtoms())) for x in []])
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=777; params.maxIterations=1000
params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed',res)
if res>=0:
 AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=500)
 conf=m.GetConformer()
 # save xyz
 with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
  f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\ninitial\n')
  for a in m.GetAtoms():
   p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx());f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.6f} {p.y:.6f} {p.z:.6f}\n')
 # distances
 for i in (8,25,42,43):
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i); q=conf.GetAtomPosition(pdi)
  import math
  print(i, math.dist(tuple(p),tuple(q)), tuple(p))
 print('pd',tuple(conf.GetAtomPosition(pdi)))

cat > make_initial.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

smi_x='CC1(C)c2cccc(P(c3ccccc3)c3ccccc3)c2Oc2c(P(c3ccccc3)c3ccccc3)cccc21'
smi_s='C1=C[C@H](Nc2ccccc2)CCC=C1' # R stereocenter

def embed(smiles, seed):
    m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles)
    p=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed=seed; p.maxIterations=2000; p.useMacrocycleTorsions=True
    assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p)==0
    # Add H coordinates and MMFF optimize
    m=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=True)
    AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1500)
    return m, np.array(m.GetConformer().GetPositions())

mx,x=embed(smi_x,25)
ms,s=embed(smi_s,41)
print('atomcounts',mx.GetNumAtoms(),ms.GetNumAtoms())
# calculate ligand P basis
p1,p2=x[8],x[25]
mid=(p1+p2)/2
axis=(p2-p1); axis/=np.linalg.norm(axis)
core=np.mean(x[[0,1,2,3,21,22,23,24,38,39,40,41]],axis=0)
vcore=core-mid
vcore-=axis*np.dot(vcore,axis)
out=-vcore/np.linalg.norm(vcore)
d=np.linalg.norm(p2-p1)
h=np.sqrt(max(2.30**2-(d/2)**2,0.05))
pd=mid+h*out
print('P-P',d,'Pd target coords',pd,'P-Pd dists',np.linalg.norm(p1-pd),np.linalg.norm(p2-pd),'out',out,'axis',axis)
# Transform substrate: alkene atoms 0 and 1. Orient ring extending away from Pd.
alk=(s[0]+s[1])/2
u=np.mean(s[[2,6,7,8,9,10,11,12,13]],axis=0)-alk # ring + N/phenyl; use only ring atoms
u=np.mean(s[[2,8,9,10,11,12,13]],axis=0)-alk
u/=np.linalg.norm(u)
v=s[1]-s[0]
v=v-np.dot(v,u)*u; v/=np.linalg.norm(v)
w=np.cross(u,v); w/=np.linalg.norm(w)
# target local axes: u->out, v->axis, w->cross
ut=out
vt=axis-np.dot(axis,ut)*ut; vt/=np.linalg.norm(vt)
wt=np.cross(ut,vt); wt/=np.linalg.norm(wt)
A=np.column_stack([u,v,w]); B=np.column_stack([ut,vt,wt]); R=B@A.T
# transform around alkene midpoint; C=C centroid is 2.0 A beyond Pd, and ring points outward
center=pd+2.0*out
s=(s-alk)@R.T+center
# Join coords. xantphos first, substrate second, Pd last
coords=np.vstack([x,s,pd.reshape(1,3)])
syms=[a.GetSymbol() for a in mx.GetAtoms()]+[a.GetSymbol() for a in ms.GetAtoms()]+['Pd']
print('all atoms',len(syms),'donor dists',np.linalg.norm(coords[8]-pd),np.linalg.norm(coords[25]-pd),np.linalg.norm(coords[74]-pd),np.linalg.norm(coords[75]-pd),'alkene',np.linalg.norm(coords[74]-coords[75]))
with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(syms)}\ninitial Pd(xantphos)(eta2 alkene), R aminocycloheptadiene\n')
 for el,pt in zip(syms,coords): f.write(f'{el} {pt[0]:.8f} {pt[1]:.8f} {pt[2]:.8f}\n')
PY
